clue.text: Rank stuff a worker may produce

parts.note: serge is a hard-wearing twilled fabric, and stuff is an old word for woven cloth
the worker ant is the crossword's standard toiler

explanation.surface: A rank smell that some labourer might give off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rank' looks like an adjective meaning foul, but it is the noun: a military grade. 'Stuff' is cloth here, not a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A sergeant is a non-commissioned grade in the army or police, one of its ranks.

clue.text: Resist making a connection

indicators.note: making signals that the letters of resist are worked into a new word

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to link up with another person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making' asks you to make something new out of RESIST's six letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A sibling is a family relation, and a connection can mean a relative.

clue.text: Gathered in study clutching exercises

indicators.note: clutching means the word for study holds the exercises inside it

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it at university
PE is physical education, school exercises

explanation.surface: Someone collected in their studies while gripping some workouts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clutching' sets the exercises in the middle of the study word, after its third letter. 'Gathered' is a harvest word, as with crops brought in.
explanation.definitionFit: Crops are reaped when they are cut and brought in at harvest.

clue.text: At one time the nurse called for a stretcher

parts.note: ex- describes something former, true at one time
one who nurses or looks after could be called a tender

explanation.surface: Long ago a nurse shouted for a stretcher to carry a patient.
explanation.walkthrough: The medical picture of a stretcher on a ward is the misdirection: the answer is a device that lengthens something.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that lengthens or prolongs an object is a stretcher in the literal sense.

clue.text: People want to be in this

definitions.text: People want to be in this

parts.words: People want to be in this
parts.note: read differently, people who are in want are in this condition of poverty, rather than wishing to join something

explanation.surface: A place everyone would like to be.
explanation.walkthrough: 'want' is the noun of poverty, not the verb of desire: people in want are in this.
explanation.definitionFit: Want and poverty are synonyms, as in the phrase 'in want'.

clue.text: Pass on some grim particulars

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A grim duty: relaying distressing details.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Pass' alone as the definition, but the answer means 'Pass on' (convey), so 'on' belongs in the definition, not as a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To convey information or knowledge to another is to hand it over, a synonym for passing it along.

clue.text: Low before Edward proposed

indicators.note: before places the cow's sound ahead of the name in the answer

parts.note: to low is to moo like a cow
Ted is a familiar short form of Edward

explanation.surface: A downcast figure came ahead of Edward in making a suggestion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Low' looks like 'downcast' but is the verb for a cow's call.
explanation.definitionFit: A point mooted is one raised or put forward for discussion.

clue.text: A baron is involved in a scrape

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters of a baron is are tangled together

explanation.surface: A nobleman has got mixed up in some trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a scrape' reads as a predicament, but here it is a graze on the skin.
explanation.definitionFit: A graze where skin is rubbed away is called a scrape.

clue.text: Row about crack made, being the more stylish

indicators.note: about means the row word goes round the crack word

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
to rend is to tear or split open

explanation.surface: A dispute about a crack someone made, as they try to look fashionable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' looks like an argument but is a line of seats; 'about' wraps it round the crack. The definition is a comparative adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Trendy means fashionable, and the comparative form means more fashionable.

clue.text: Look at a range that's less lavish

parts.note: to scan is to look over closely
a tier is a range or row, as of seats

explanation.surface: Inspect a cooker that turns out to be stingier.
explanation.definitionFit: Scant means barely sufficient, so the comparative is meaner and sparser.

clue.text: Crusoe's disastrous voyage

indicators.note: disastrous suggests the name Crusoe has been wrecked into a new order

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Robinson Crusoe's ill-fated sea journey that ended in shipwreck.
explanation.walkthrough: Robinson Crusoe is the castaway hero of Defoe's novel, wrecked on a voyage, so the surface fits his story.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship's route across the sea is its course, the passage it takes.

clue.text: Skinhead having to pay for room

indicators.note: head of the word skin means only its opening letter is used

parts.note: a wage is pay for work

explanation.surface: A shaven-headed youth must pay for lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Skinhead' reads as a person, but splits into 'skin' and its 'head', the letter S.
explanation.definitionFit: Space for storing cargo or goods aboard is room, as in storage space.

clue.text: Go off each and every player

definitions.text: Go off each and every player

parts.words: Go off each and every player
parts.note: a stage direction telling all the actors to leave the stage together

explanation.surface: An instruction that the whole cast should leave.
explanation.walkthrough: This Latin stage direction means 'they go out', telling all the actors to leave together.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin stage direction for actors leaving is the plural for their departure.

clue.text: Rejected sweets but still put weight on

indicators.note: rejected means the word for sweets is turned back to front

parts.note: desserts are sweets, the pudding course

explanation.surface: Someone turned down pudding but gained weight anyway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put weight on' looks like getting fatter, but it means emphasised. 'Rejected' turns DESSERTS round.
explanation.definitionFit: To emphasise a word or syllable is to lay emphasis or stress on it.

clue.text: Send a note on what is to be worn

parts.note: D is a musical note
a dress is a garment to be worn

explanation.surface: Post a message about what to wear.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces sit side by side, with 'on' just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To direct a letter to someone is to write its destination, sending it their way.

clue.text: Lower? Blow!

definitions.meaning: to let a thing down is to lower it, as on a rope
a disappointment, a setback that comes as a blow

explanation.surface: Two curt exclamations, as if a frustrated person were muttering.
explanation.definitionFit: Lowering a rope means paying it out downwards, and a disappointment is a blow.

clue.text: Spot a little animal seldom seen

definitions.meaning: a small dark blemish on the skin
a small burrowing creature that lives underground

explanation.surface: Glimpse a shy creature that rarely shows itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark skin blemish shares its name with the burrowing creature that lives underground, out of sight.

clue.text: Training that's really boring

definitions.meaning: military practice on the parade ground
literally making holes with a bit, not tedium

explanation.surface: Some instruction that turns out to be extremely dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Parade-ground practice is drill, and boring a hole with a bit is drill work too.

clue.text: It's sea-food for the board, not hash

parts.note: a plank is a board of timber

indicators.note: hash means a mess, so the word not is jumbled

explanation.surface: This is seafood for the dinner table, not a dish of hash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hash' looks like a dish but signals the anagram of NOT, giving TON. 'sea-food' is literal: food floating in the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiny drifting organisms are the food of many marine creatures, food in the sea.

clue.text: Overrun in a French engagement

parts.note: un is the French word for a
a date is an engagement or appointment

explanation.surface: Being swamped while attending a French appointment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a French' gives UN, the French for 'a'.
explanation.definitionFit: To flood or swamp something is to overrun it.

clue.text: Turn the record

definitions.meaning: to turn over and over, as a ball does

explanation.surface: Flip the vinyl over to its other side.
explanation.definitionFit: Rotating over and over is rolling, and an official list of names is a roll.

clue.text: Robber group carrying equipment

indicators.note: carrying means the group word holds the equipment word inside it

parts.note: a band is a group
a rig is a set of equipment

explanation.surface: A thief's gang carrying their gear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carrying' means the gang word holds the gear inside it; 'group' and 'equipment' both sit easily in the surface's picture of a thief's gang.
explanation.definitionFit: A bandit who robs travellers is a highway thief.

clue.text: Agitated sleuth's frenzied activity

indicators.note: agitated suggests the letters of sleuth are stirred up

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A flustered detective's hectic investigation.
explanation.definitionFit: Hurried, bustling busyness is a synonym for frantic bustle.

clue.text: Like occupying the finest housing-or the worst

indicators.note: occupying means the word for like sits inside another word
housing means the word for the finest holds another word inside

parts.note: the best is the finest
as can mean like, as in 'as a child'

explanation.surface: Being in the best homes, or the poorest.
explanation.walkthrough: Both 'occupying' and 'housing' describe the one insertion from either side, so neither is spare. The dash before 'or the worst' marks the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Base means low or vile, so its superlative means the lowest, most vile.

clue.text: Superior punter

definitions.meaning: someone who places a bet, a gambler

explanation.surface: A gambler who rates himself above the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A higher-grade thing is superior, and a gambler who places a wager is one who bets.

clue.text: Get depressed when left suffering

parts.note: anguish is severe suffering

explanation.surface: Someone sinks into gloom when abandoned in pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' reads as abandoned but is just L.
explanation.definitionFit: To languish is to pine or lose vigour, becoming low in spirits.

clue.text: Damaging a green might well cause anger

indicators.note: damaging means the words a green are knocked into a different order

explanation.surface: Ruining a golf course green would make the groundsman furious.
explanation.walkthrough: A green is a putting surface on a golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: To make someone furious is to provoke fury, the same as infuriating them.

clue.text: A server of drinks entered in the beauty contest

indicators.note: entered in says the answer sits within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A barmaid has been put forward for a beauty pageant.
explanation.walkthrough: Hebe was the Greek goddess who poured nectar for the gods; the name is tucked across 'the beauty'.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this goddess of youth was cupbearer to the gods, pouring their nectar.

clue.text: Being nice about plug falling off

indicators.note: about means the word for nice goes round the word for plug

parts.note: decent means nice or pleasant
a plug is a promotion, an advertisement, abbreviated ad

explanation.surface: Being pleasant about an electrical plug that keeps falling out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plug' is a puff or advert (AD), not an electrical fitting. 'falling off' means declining.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in moral or cultural decline is decaying, deteriorating from a higher state.

clue.text: Companies have a point in supplying running water

indicators.note: have means the companies word holds the point inside it

parts.note: gangs are companies of people
E is east, a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Firms that have a purpose in providing tap water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Companies' are businesses in the surface but gangs of people here. The Ganges is India's great sacred river.
explanation.definitionFit: A river is a body of flowing water.

clue.text: Copier salesman facing consumer

indicators.note: facing puts the salesman word ahead of and looking towards the consumer word

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
an eater consumes food

explanation.surface: A photocopier salesman meets a customer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copier' suggests an office machine, but it is one that repeats.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that repeats or reproduces things over and over is a copier in the literal sense.
